comment: Prototypes given to IDA by hand because the decompiler's own guess loses arguments. Applied by tools/ida/add_functions.py before it decompiles. Callers must be re-decompiled afterwards.

prototypes.0044EE70: void __usercall hit_wall_dust(unsigned int world_id@<ecx>, vector2d *position@<edx>, vector2d *direction);
prototypes.00416E60: char __usercall blueprint_char_place@<al>(int blueprint_type@<ecx>, int x, int y, char code, int layer);

why.0044EE70: ecx, edx, then one stack argument that the CALLER removes (add esp,4 after every call), so it is not __fastcall; with __fastcall three of the five call sites lost the third argument. Parameter list matches the assert signature void hit_wall_dust(unsigned int, vector2d *, vector2d *); the parameter names are guesses.
why.00416E60: The building type arrives in ecx (blueprint_fill_arrays loads ecx from [ebp-4] before each of its four calls) next to four stack arguments; IDA's __cdecl guess dropped it, so the '@' template character (the building's resident NPC) switched on garbage and no resident was ever placed. The function name and parameter names are guesses (no assert string names it).
